physicalNotes: Radius 98.304 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 112961: radius 98.304 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 1630.73 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.103) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 68,390,093 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Temperature 3702 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 112961: effective temperature 3702 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.181) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
